about.en: Choise.ai (formerly Choise.com, launched in 2017) is a crypto company offering white-label crypto banking, wallet, exchange and earning infrastructure to businesses and fintechs, alongside its own consumer apps. CHO is its ecosystem token, an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xBBa39Fd2935d5769116ce38d46a71bde9cf03099 (named choise.com Token on-chain), also deployed on BNB Chain and Solana.
